import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Conjecture about cardinality of Lindelöf spaces

The conjecture asks for a Lindelöf space where all singletons are G_δ sets
and which has cardinality > 𝔠.

This is Problem 1 in https://www.math.md/files/basm/y2013-n2-3/y2013-n2-3-(pp37-46).pdf.pdf

*Reference:*
* [Selected Old Open Problems in General Topology](https://www.math.md/files/basm/y2013-n2-3/y2013-n2-3-(pp37-46).pdf.pdf)
  by A. V. Arhangel’skii

-/

open Cardinal

namespace CardinalityLindelof

/--
Is there a Lindelöf space with singletons as Gδ sets with cardinality greater than the continuum?
-/
@[category research open, AMS 54]
theorem HasGδSingletons.lindelof_card :
    ∃ (X : Type) (_ : TopologicalSpace X), HasGδSingletons X ∧ LindelofSpace X ∧ 𝔠 < #X := by
  sorry

-- TODO: under additional axioms (consistent with ZFC), such a space exists.

end CardinalityLindelof

findings.description: The existential statement omits the source’s Tychonoff requirement. Neither `HasGδSingletons X` nor `LindelofSpace X` includes this separation condition: Gδ singletons imply T₁, but not Hausdorffness or complete regularity. Thus the Lean permits spaces outside the class specified by the paper. This is not repaired by the cardinal bound: a Lean-checked conditional construction adjoins the countable cofinite space to any large witness, preserving Gδ singletons, Lindelöfness, and cardinality greater than the continuum, while producing a non-Tychonoff space.
findings.source_evidence: Arhangel’skii, Selected Old Open Problems in General Topology, p. 38, immediately before §2: “A ‘space’ below is a Tychonoff topological space.” Problem 1 asks whether a Lindelöf space whose points are Gδ must have cardinality at most 2^ω; the following paragraph explicitly requests a ZFC counterexample. https://www.math.md/files/basm/y2013-n2-3/y2013-n2-3-(pp37-46).pdf.pdf
findings.suggested_fix: Require `T35Space X`, Mathlib’s Tychonoff class: `∃ (X : Type) (_ : TopologicalSpace X), T35Space X ∧ HasGδSingletons X ∧ LindelofSpace X ∧ 𝔠 < #X`. Also mention Tychonoffness in the docstring.
